name: BirdCLEF 2021: Avian Vocalization Benchmark
description: BirdCLEF 2021 is a large-scale bioacoustic benchmark for automated bird call identification in continuous soundscape recordings. Organized under LifeCLEF and hosted on Kaggle, it features 62,884 focal audio recordings covering 397 bird species native to North, Central, and South America contributed via the Xeno-canto network (with 62,874 usable focal recordings), alongside 80 continuous soundscape test recordings and 20 training soundscapes.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial (Xeno-canto Terms)
license.notes: Audio recordings were contributed by community recordists to Xeno-canto under individual Creative Commons licenses (chiefly CC-BY-NC-SA and CC-BY-NC). The Kaggle challenge dataset is governed by competition rules restricting use strictly to non-commercial academic research and conservation evaluation.

verification.notes: Verified against CLEF 2021 working notes (CEUR-WS Vol-2936, pp. 1437-1450) and official Kaggle data specifications. `train_metadata.csv` documents exactly 62,884 focal training recordings in `train_short_audio/` covering 397 avian species. In benchmark execution, 10 recordings (e.g. unreadable/corrupted files) are excluded by standard preprocessing pipelines, leaving 62,874 usable focal recordings. An additional 80 continuous 10-minute soundscapes are provided for test evaluation alongside 20 training soundscapes.

size.notes: OGG Vorbis short audio recordings (train_short_audio), CSV metadata annotations, and continuous soundscape audio recordings.
